summary: Riverside kerb crowded with parked cars, backing onto bush; no homes.

drivers.seclusion: River bank bush on the east; sports fields and university buildings on the west, no homes.

drivers.traffic: Riverside campus road; quiet at night.
drivers.convention: Dense parking along this kerb under the metered University zone; a van blends in.
